messages:
incident-bot: Pager: elevated gateway 504s for production (svc: inference-gateway) — pages: evan (oncall) :rotating_light:

evan (oncall): seeing 504 spike + increased tail latency. Alerts show 504 rate ~8% over 5m. Impact: some hosted API requests timing out. Tags: region-us-west, model-v2.

sasha (sre): are traces coming through for failed requests? I'm not seeing span ids for a lot of those requests.

evan (oncall): looks sparse. most failed requests have no request-id header in traces. logs show generic upstream timeout from nginx -> runtime.

maria (infra): I can enable debug proxy logging on the gateway for the next 30m. that'll add request headers and upstream timing in logs. Want me to roll?

evan (oncall): do it. also, can we temporarily relax trace sampling so we capture the failures?

sasha (sre): on it — increasing sampling to 100% for requests with response_status >= 500 and to 10% for all requests for 15m.

ops-bot: Deploy started: gateway-debug-logs-2026-03-15 (canary) by maria. CI job #4521.

maria (infra): canary deployed to 2 nodes in us-west. debug logs enabled. snippet I applied:
```
# nginx extra_log_format
log_format debug_req '$remote_addr - $remote_user [$time_local] "$request" '
                     'status=$status upstream_time=$upstream_response_time request_id=$http_x_request_id';
access_log /var/log/nginx/debug_access.log debug_req;
```

lia (support): getting a support ticket from a big customer complaining about repeated timeouts while sending long prompts. They saw retries and idempotency kicks in.

devon (runtime): runtime metrics show increased KV cache misses for long-context requests — recv queue depth spikes leading to upstream timeouts. Possibly continuous batching spikes.

evan (oncall): summary: gateway timeouts likely due to backend runtime stalls under long-sequence load + missing request-id propagation causing trace gaps. Need stopgap: force passthrough request-id header, increase runtime worker timeout, and add temporary request-level metrics for queue depth + batch size.

sasha (sre): I'll patch the gateway to forward X-Request-Id header and add a short-lived metric tag. patch:
```
# nginx conf snippet
proxy_set_header X-Request-Id $http_x_request_id;
proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
```
and add prometheus metric: gateway_request_queue_depth.
```

maria (infra): rolled forward-request-id patch to canary, enabling header passthrough.

ops-bot: Metric push: gateway_request_queue_depth exposed from gateway canary.

lia (support): flagged impacted customers and opened a communication draft. Customer ops may want a rollback window.

evan (oncall): devon — can you flip runtime worker timeout from 15s -> 30s on the dedicated pool as a temporary mitigation? Might hide slow batches but prevent 504s.

devon (runtime): I can bump up upstream timeout and enable slower worker backoff. Doing a rolling change to dedicated pool only. command:
```
# k8s patch
kubectl -n runtime set env deploy/runtime-worker TIMEOUT=30s --record
```

ops-bot: Runtime config rollout started for dedicated pool (3 nodes).

sasha (sre): with debug logs + request-id passthrough we should get traces for the failed requests now. Also set trace-sampling flag to 100% for status>=500 remains active.

(monitoring): I'm seeing 504 rate drop from 8% -> 3% after the runtime timeout bump, but tail latency still elevated.

evan (oncall): good reduction in customer-facing 504s. still want KV cache investigation next. devon to own.

devon (runtime): looking at batching logs — some large batches with many long-sequence requests cause eviction and stall. I'll add a quick stopgap to cap max batch size for long sequences. patching code path now.

maria (infra): note — debug logs are noisy. I will remove debug_access for non-canary after 30m and rotate logs.

lia (support): customer comms drafted: "we identified elevated gateway timeouts affecting long-request workloads; temporary mitigations applied; we continue to investigate root cause. We'll follow up once fixed." Want approval to send.

evan (oncall): approve. send.

sasha (sre): prepping post-incident checklist: 1) reconcile missing traces (we got request-ids now) 2) add persistent request-id propagation test in e2e 3) add synthetic load tests for long-context requests 4) evaluate batching heuristics.

ops-bot: Incident severity downgraded to S3 — service partially degraded, mitigation in place.

evan (oncall): handing off to sasha for overnight monitoring and follow-up. leaving notes in incident doc: https://redwood-internal/incidents/1768504321 (draft).

sasha (sre): taking over. I'll keep the sampling bump for another 30m then scale back to targeted sampling after we confirm traces are stable.

lia (support): customer notified. they asked for request-ids for the failed requests — can we export those?

sasha (sre): yes, once logs are parsed I will export request-id list for liaison.

maria (infra): cleaning canary debug logs in 20m, pushing normal log_format back.

ops-bot: Deploy finished: gateway-debug-logs-2026-03-15.

evan (oncall): thanks team. quick retro items: surface request-id propagation in the console, add alert for high queue_depth, and a runbook for long-context load.

sasha (sre): noted. I'll own runbook and tracking ticket.

ops-bot: Thread archived by ops-bot.
